## #0 — The whole that keeps its opening
The torus is whole through the opening it retains. In its familiar bodily image, the surface turns around a passage that is not another patch of surface. To fill that passage in the name of completing the form would alter the very relation to be completed. Wholeness is already this inseparability; circulation unfolds it. The [arche-topos as differential field](A16-Arche-Topos-as-Differential-Field.md) gives the relation its positions, and [the two logics of two](A13-Two-Logics-of-Two-Dia-Syn.md) distinguish a determination that exhausts its account in opposed terms from one that carries their containing relation through the opposition.
The uroboros makes the relation bodily. Its head meets its tail, but a circumference does not exhaust the creature. There is a mouth, a receiving inside, an outside and a body capable of transformation. Eating its own tail implicates the receiver in what it receives. The opening belongs to the complete self-relation before any particular meal begins. Its apparent absence is a condition of the form's positive life.
This is the ground of the mathematical passage: a finite form can carry a relation to an inexhaustible field, and a return to the same address can retain a difference. The operations which make that claim exact begin with identification, not with a picture of a doughnut.
## #1 — One address, infinitely many lifts

Take the plane and identify points separated by integer translations:
(x,y)\sim(x+m,y+n),\quad (m,n)\in\mathbb Z^2.
The quotient assigns one address to each equivalence class. The point represented by $(1/4,1/3)$ is also represented by $(5/4,1/3)$, $(1/4,4/3)$ and infinitely many further translates. Nothing has made these plane-points equal as plane-points. The quotient identifies them for a new space, and the covering map
\pi:\mathbb R^2\longrightarrow\mathbb T^2
states how the two spaces are related. One compact surface can therefore be addressed through an unbounded covering plane. The finite and infinite belong to a single construction in different offices.
A square supplies a fundamental region. Glue its opposite sides in corresponding directions. All four corners then represent one vertex; each opposite pair of edges becomes one edge; the interior contributes one face. The resulting cell count is
$$
\chi(\mathbb T^2)=1-2+1=0.
$$
Four sides before gluing and two generating edge classes give one geometrical reading of `4+2`. They must remain distinct from the one vertex, two edges and one face after gluing. The construction neither leaves four separate vertices on the quotient nor counts the opening as an additional cell. [Hatcher's quotient, cell and covering constructions](../sources/mathematics-logic/hatcher/hatcher-2002-algebraic-topology/SOURCE.md#hatcher-2002-algebraic-topology-p001) establish these mathematical offices.

The slash here denotes a quotient by an equivalence relation. QL's `∞/0` brings the infinite cover and zero Euler characteristic into one reading of the construction. It does not instruct arithmetic to divide infinity by zero. The [change of dimensional frame](../concepts/C52-Dimensional-Reframing-at-Zero-and-Infinity.md) occurs by specifying another space and its relation to the first. The flat metric inherited from the plane also differs from the induced metric of a torus embedded in ordinary three-dimensional space. The quotient and the bodily picture retain their relation without exchanging all their properties.

## #2 — Returning with a difference

Choose a starting point on the plane over a starting point on the torus. A continuous path downstairs has a unique lift from that chosen starting point. A closed path on the torus need not close on the plane. For

$$
\gamma(t)=[2t,-t],\quad 0\leq t\leq1,
$$

the projected endpoints coincide, while the lifted path from $(0,0)$ ends at $(2,-1)$. Local closure retains a displacement in the cover. The two integers count independent windings, giving
One loop reversed would give a generator and its inverse. Here there are two independent generators: changing the winding in one direction need not change it in the other. A path with class $(2,-1)$ goes twice around one generator and once in the reverse direction of the other.
The endpoint displacement records the homotopy class, not the complete journey. A straight lift and a lift that makes a small detour can end at the same lattice point. Speed can change without changing that endpoint at all. Thus class, travelled path and temporal enactment preserve different information. A claim about retained history must say which of these it retains. The [travelling jigsaw](../../mytheme/worlds/frank-taylor/travelling-jigsaw-atlas/WHOLE.md#jigsaw-mathematical-witness) carries precisely this change: returning to a familiar piece need not cancel what the traveller has traversed.
A linear flow $t\mapsto[t,\alpha t]$ closes when a positive time $T$ makes both $T$ and $\alpha T$ integers. A rational slope permits such a period; an irrational slope does not. In the latter case the flow winds densely. Boundarylessness therefore permits both periodic return and traversal without a closing period. It does not compel a trajectory to repeat.
The plane covering the torus and the torus double-covering the Klein bottle are different constructions. Integer translations give infinitely many lifts over each torus point. In the Klein-bottle construction, adding a glide-reflection to a translation group introduces the orientation-reversing identification; its translation subgroup has index two, producing a two-sheeted torus cover. [The covering-space distinction](../sources/mathematics-logic/hatcher/hatcher-2002-algebraic-topology/SOURCE.md#hatcher-2002-algebraic-topology-p003) preserves both maps instead of treating every return as the same inversion.
## #3 — The creature and its costume
A sphere has no non-contractible loop classes. This distinguishes its topology from the torus without depriving a sphere of motion. The uroboric trick concerns what an image claims to contain: the round outline presents its own smooth completeness as the whole creature. Mouth, inner passage and the opening around which the body bends are lost from the account. The trick succeeds by making an actual aspect exhaustive.
The [complete uroboros](../../mytheme/archetypal-ground/uroboros-trickster/WHOLE.md#uroboros-interposition) restores the missing relation through position, opposition, superposition and interposition. Position gives the visible round; opposition differentiates the hungry head and the offered tail; superposition holds receiving and being received within one living body; interposition gathers their winding with the opening it cannot occupy. Assimilation changes the life that receives. The Saturnine, blocked-gut variant receives only to detain, preventing what is taken in from changing the ruling form. The Eden-serpent's fork gives another consequence of the lost opening: opposed valuations claim to exhaust the field that made their discrimination possible.
In this bodily `4+2`, the final weave keeps four explicate twisting field-lines together with the axis and opening gathered at `#0`; `#5` is the whole enfolding the differentiated winding. These are the image's named offices. The counted objects differ from the square's four sides and two generators; the relation crosses registers through a specified correspondence. Anuttara/Paramaśiva bears the opening. Māyā is Śakti's productive measure-field around it, the patterns through which manifestation can return in recognition. Wholeness does not abolish these distinctions. [Complexio oppositorum](../concepts/C36-Complexio-Oppositorum.md) holds their belonging together, while [the arche-topos](../concepts/C20-Arche-Topos.md) makes differentiation within that whole available.
The opening and the achieved whole frame the six interior determinations without replacing their eight-turn theorem. The parent relation opens into source and manifestation; questioning and assertion differentiate it; need and power give it movement; capacity and particularity make its recurring form legible; the copula makes it personed; an indefinite horizon receives the definite passage. The return-switch turns the achieved determination toward its source. [The eight determinations](A18-Primordial-Symbolon-and-Its-Eight-Determinations.md) carry that complete sequence and its internal harmonics. The toroidal body lets the whole be traversed; its sixfold exposition does not renumber the theorem.

## #4 — A remainder that completes the return

The two Spanda readings arrive at the musical relation by different but connected operations. The first unfolds differentiation and its return to standing `1/1`. The second recounts that completed hundred through $2^6+6^2=64+36$. Dividing both terms by four yields 16 and 9; taking their ratio is a further operation, not an equality between the sum and the quotient. In $2^4/3^2$, four binary instances and two ternary instances give the vertical `4:2` reading.

The horizontal `3:3` follows first-, second- and third-person perspectives through the voiding of their isolation, recognition of one appearing-act and its return as `0/1`. From the latter unity, the three perspectives are also `3:1`. Cross-comparing `4:2` and `3:3` yields the directional ratios $4/3$ and $2/3$; inversion gives $3/4$ and $3/2$. The [ratio derivation](A15-Ratio-Rationality-Measure-Reckoning-Harmony-Account.md) makes their returning difference audible:
\frac{64}{36}=\frac{16}{9}=\left(\frac43\right)^2,
\qquad
\frac{3/2}{4/3}=\frac98,
\qquad
The whole tone separating fifth from fourth also carries $16/9$ into the octave. Completion works through the remainder. A doubled frequency returns as an octave relation while retaining its difference from the starting frequency. The winding vector and the frequency ratio are different mathematical objects; each makes return-with-difference exact in its own operation. [Homologia and analogia](../etymologies/homology-and-analogy/WHOLE-FIELD.md#e5-whole-returns) let the comparison preserve that difference.
The [musical derivation's two endings](../sources/internal-corpus/taylor/taylor-2026-ql-musical-derivation-v3/SOURCE.md), §II-5.10, distinguish operational recurrence from telic recognition. One completed passage becomes the condition of another performance. In the other ending, the standing relation enacted through the performance is recognised; the bellows may fall still. Wholeness cannot depend on compulsory further production, since the capacity for articulation remains in the silence from which another performance can begin.
Energetic containment gives the winding a material neighbour. In [a tokamak](../sources/physics/iter/iter-what-is-tokamak/SOURCE.md#iter-what-is-tokamak-q001), a doughnut-shaped vacuum chamber and magnetic fields confine charged plasma while its activity continues. The vessel supports an active process rather than replacing movement with an inert boundary. The uroboros's discharge/confinement pair places this held activity beside the release of what an achieved account excluded. Their different consequences remain active: receiving power, holding it and releasing it are different acts. The engineering apparatus supplies the confinement instance; the metaphysical relation is developed through the whole argument.
## #5→0 — What comes home
The traveller returns to a recognisable address with a changed relation to the field. [The mathematics history](../histories/traditions-and-disciplines/mathematics/DEVELOPMENT.md#3--re-entry-representation-and-retained-passage) receives the exact distinction between class and complete passage. The jigsaw receives a whole that is encountered through situated pieces and the transitions among them rather than exhausted by a picture printed on the lid. The uroboros receives a mouth through which its own achieved form can be transformed. These are different returns from a common pressure: local completion need not abolish dependence or difference.
That pressure becomes technical in [traversal with return](../conjugate/A17-prime-Traversal-with-Return.md). A result can pass into an action and become a condition of a later result. To discover what this passage retained, an inquiry must follow its actual sources, choices, criteria and consequences. The integer winding pair is an exact example of retained difference, not a substitute for those records. [Agentworld's relay and recomposing group](../sources/media-technology-philosophy/bratton/bratton-2026-agentworld-brief/SOURCE.md) give the question a concrete scenario: what changes when coherence passes through agents and artifacts, and which relations survive that passage?
The [symbol, account and trust field](../etymologies/symbol-account-and-trust/WHOLE-FIELD.md) returns an achieved account to the relation from which it can answer. An apparent contradiction may require [a changed containing field](../concepts/C64-Paradox-Transforming-the-Containing-Field.md), preserving the local truths that the old account could not hold together. Recognition then reaches the terms of further reception, not merely the next item received.
[Integral Zero](A36-Advent-of-Integral-Zero.md) receives this completed movement. The surface remains determinate, the two windings remain distinct, and the opening remains constitutive of their whole. A further act is possible; it is no longer demanded as the price of wholeness.
